info.name: MTN Morpheus WhatsApp QA
info.description: Secret-free QA collection. Configure local variables from the supplied request. Run baseline alone first. Do not run every folder with the same conversation ID: use the Python harness for fresh sessions and evidence scoring. Write, payment, injected-failure and manual-only scenarios are in the Python catalogue. B-authentication must be configured independently for session-isolation tests.
